guideContent.strategyOverview: Zhulodok cascade deck with infinite mana combos, flash cascade storms, and every Eldrazi titan. Cascades 4+ times per spell with Echoes of Eternity, wins with infinite mana loops, and locks opponents out with Void Winnower and Emrakul.

winConditions.title: Infinite Mana into Eldrazi Army
winConditions.description: Generate infinite colorless mana via Basalt Monolith + Forsaken Monument (tap for 4, untap for 3). Use Eye of Ugin repeatedly to tutor every Eldrazi from the library onto the battlefield. Alternatively, Rings of Brighthearth + Basalt Monolith or Voltaic Construct + Karn, the Great Creator + any mana rock achieve the same infinite mana.

winConditions.title: Cascade Storm
winConditions.description: Cast any 7+ mana spell to cascade twice via Zhulodok. Echoes of Eternity doubles each cascade trigger to four, and copies each cascaded spell. A single cast generates 9+ spells. Glaring Fleshraker triggers on each colorless cast, creating Spawn tokens and dealing 1 damage per opponent. One resolved chain deals 4+ damage and floods the board.

winConditions.title: Emrakul Turn Lock
winConditions.description: Cast Emrakul to control an opponent's turn. At their end step, bounce Emrakul with Erratic Portal. Vedalken Orrery grants flash, Unwinding Clock untaps Portal each opponent's turn. Recast Emrakul targeting the next opponent. Permanently control all opponents' turns in sequence.

winConditions.title: Annihilator Lockout
winConditions.description: Deploy multiple Eldrazi titans through cascade or infinite mana. Annihilator triggers force opponents to sacrifice permanents on each attack. Void Winnower prevents opponents from casting even-cost spells and blocking with even-power creatures. Two attack steps with multiple titans strips 10+ permanents and locks opponents out of the game.

winConditions.title: Artifact Storm: Infinite Draw and Damage
winConditions.description: Mystic Forge casts Top from library top. With a cost reducer (Ugin, the Ineffable or Foundry Inspector), Top costs 0. Tap Top to draw and place it back on top. Recast from library via Forge. Each cast triggers Glaring Fleshraker for 1 damage to each opponent plus a Spawn token. Repeat for infinite draw and lethal damage.

synergies.title: Quadruple Cascade
synergies.description: Each 7+ MV spell cascades 4 times instead of 2, AND each cascaded spell gets copied. One spell becomes 9+ spells.

synergies.title: Infinite Mana: Monument Combo
synergies.description: Monolith taps for 4 (3+1 from Monument), untaps for 3 = infinite colorless mana. Feed into Eye of Ugin to tutor every Eldrazi.

synergies.title: Infinite Mana: Key-Rings Engine
synergies.description: Key untaps a mana rock for 1, Rings copies Key targeting itself for 2. With any rock that taps for 4+ (e.g., Basalt Monolith + Forsaken Monument), this nets infinite mana. Thran Dynamo produces 3, enabling infinite untaps but not net mana.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook
sources.detail: Infinite colorless mana (full combo also requires Forsaken Monument)

synergies.title: Flash Cascade Storm
synergies.description: Cast 7+ MV Eldrazi at instant speed on opponents' turns via Liberator or Orrery. Each cascade spawns tokens + 1 damage per opponent via Fleshraker. With Echoes, 4+ damage per chain.

sources.name: The Command Zone Ep 551
sources.detail: Flash Eldrazi + Unwinding Clock synergy discussed

synergies.title: Colossus Recursion Loop
synergies.description: Cast Colossus free, cascade twice, sac to KCI for 2 mana, sac 2 Fleshraker spawn tokens to return Colossus from graveyard, recast and repeat.

synergies.title: Ugin Exile Machine
synergies.description: Every colorless spell you cast exiles a colored permanent. With 3+ spells per cascade chain, strip 3+ enemy permanents per turn.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Ugin Eye of the Storms cascade interaction

synergies.title: Infinite Mana: Rings-Basalt Loop
synergies.description: Tap Basalt for 3. Pay 3 to untap. Rings copies the untap for 2 (need 2 initial mana from another source). Copy untap resolves first, tap Basalt for 3 more, then original untap resolves. Nets 1 per loop.

synergies.title: Artifact Storm: Top-Forge Engine
synergies.description: Ugin reduces colorless costs by 2, making Top free. Forge casts Top from library top. Tap Top to draw, putting it back on top. Repeat for infinite card draw.

synergies.title: Fleshraker Storm Loop
synergies.description: Forge casts Top from library for 1. Fleshraker triggers on colorless cast: creates Spawn token, deals 1 damage. Sacrifice Spawn for 1 mana to recast Top after tapping it to draw. Self-sustaining loop: infinite draw + near-infinite damage.

synergies.title: Infinite Draw: Inspector-Forge Engine
synergies.description: Inspector reduces Top's cost by 1 (free with Forge's top-of-library cast). Tap Top to draw, it goes on top, Forge casts it again for free. Infinite card draw without needing Ugin's cost reduction.

synergies.title: Karn's Construct Engine
synergies.description: Karn's +1 animates Basalt Monolith (or Thran Dynamo, Mana Vault) into an artifact creature. Construct pays {2} to untap it. Rock taps for 3+ mana, netting 1+ per loop = infinite colorless mana. Feed into Eye of Ugin to tutor every Eldrazi.

synergies.title: Emrakul Turn Lock
synergies.description: Cast Emrakul to control an opponent's turn. On their end step, Portal bounces Emrakul (Orrery grants flash, Clock untaps Portal each opponent's turn). Recast Emrakul targeting next opponent. Repeat every turn cycle = permanent control of all opponents' turns.
